vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: nginx-config
Version: 1.0.3

The Nginx Config skill is a legitimate utility for generating Nginx configuration templates. The primary script, `scripts/nginx.sh`, uses standard bash templating to output configurations for reverse proxies, SSL, static hosting, and security hardening based on user-provided arguments. It does not execute any destructive commands, access sensitive files, or perform network operations.

llm.summary: The skill's files and instructions are consistent with an nginx configuration generator: it contains templates and a shell script that prints configuration snippets, requests no credentials, and performs no network or file-exfiltration actions.

dimensions.detail: The name/description match the included assets: SKILL.md describes nginx config generation and scripts/nginx.sh generates nginx config templates (reverse proxy, SSL, static, security, load‑balancer). The skill does not request unrelated environment variables or external credentials.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs usage like 'nginx-config help' but the included script is named nginx.sh (Usage: nginx.sh ...). This is a minor mismatch in the CLI name/packaging; otherwise the instructions do not direct the agent to read system secrets, transmit data externally, or perform unexpected file system actions. The script only emits config text (uses date) and does not itself write files or call external services.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec (instruction-only), which is low risk. However, a runnable script is bundled (scripts/nginx.sh) and will be installed as a file with the skill; there are no downloads or archives and no external install URLs.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The script references default filesystem paths (e.g., /etc/letsencrypt/live) only in generated text — it does not read those files or require access to them.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request persistent system privileges. The bundled script does not modify system configuration or other skills' settings — it only prints configuration snippets. It will only affect the system if a user saves or applies the generated configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: generate nginx configuration templates. Before using it: (1) inspect scripts/nginx.sh locally (which you've already seen) and confirm the CLI name you expect (SKILL.md references 'nginx-config' while the script is 'nginx.sh'); (2) never pipe generated output directly into root-level commands (e.g., avoid piping straight into sudo tee or automatic nginx reload) — save and review the config before applying; (3) adapt default paths (e.g., /etc/letsencrypt/live) and resource limits to your environment; and (4) if you plan to run the script on production, test in a staging environment first. Overall this skill is coherent and does not request secrets or perform hidden network/file operations.
